items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: George Raft and all the movie stars used to come in there.

ctx.x: Now, how many people did it hold, about?
That I can't tell you, but the Cotton Club must have held -- George Raft and all the movie stars used to come in there. I can't tell you.
Do you think it held 300 people?
